title: overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal still omits growth_on — the cfg-mirror parity gap the r3 fold closed for advance_gate_on persists one field up
evidence:
harness/overlay.odin:46-52:
	cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = d.name,
		use_fixture = d.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = d.qos_fixture,
		advance_gate_on = d.advance_gate_on, // 6.2 r2 W2: the B1 flag-threading's residual site — the overlay verb re-sims the gate demos gate-ON too, or its verification frame shows the wrong sim
		session = {goal = d.win_goal, cap_ms = d.lose_cap_ms, health_on = d.health_on, surge_win_pct = d.surge_win_pct},
	}
harness/run.odin:280-281:
		growth_on = demo.growth_on, // 5.1: run setup — the director's map growth
		advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on, // 6.2: run setup — the era-advance gate (r1 B1: the live/bless path MUST carry the flag ...)
harness/run.odin:695-696:
	cfg.growth_on = demo.growth_on // 5.1: run setup — re-created identically on replay
	cfg.advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on // 6.2: run setup — re-created identically on replay
harness/run.odin:643: state.growth_enabled = cfg.growth_on
demos/growth.dem:32: growth on
demos/node_health.dem:30: growth on
demos/terminal_types.dem:24: growth on
detail: Both peer cfg sites (run_demo, load_demo_replay) carry growth_on + advance_gate_on; the overlay literal carries only advance_gate_on. overlay-check <growth-demo> re-sims with growth_enabled=false, showing a static map — the exact 'wrong sim' failure the fix's comment describes.
recommended_fix: Add `growth_on = d.growth_on,` to overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal (harness/overlay.odin:46), mirroring run.odin:280.
